_comment: Flat key -> value bag — see config/secrets/README.md. Reference a key from a dataset as ${thatKey} (e.g. "email": "${webValidUserEmail}") and it's resolved automatically, no code needed in specs. browserstackUsername/browserstackAccessKey are read directly (not via a dataset) by config/wdio.android.conf.ts / wdio.ios.conf.ts when MOBILE_EXECUTION_TARGET=browserstack — see config/browserstackCapabilityBuilder.ts. Copy this file to qa.secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in real values.
